Hub updates

All updates →
FeatureOct 14, 2026

XRPL Facilitator adds batch settlement on XRPL Checks

In closed beta on mainnet since October 14, the XRPL Facilitator can settle many x402 payments with one XRPL Check, a native XRP Ledger feature. XRPL's standard fee was already the lowest of the x402 networks we measured; in a session it falls to a fraction of a drop per paid request.

10 → 0.36 drops
XRPL network fee per paid request, mainnet, Oct 14–17
Read more →
  1. FeatureOct 21, 2026

    The home dashboard now reads in USD

    Value settled is shown in USD, with XRP valued at each day's closing XRP/RLUSD rate on the XRP Ledger. New cards show volume settled and registered services, and Settlement activity plots the last 12 weeks.

  2. New merchantOct 20, 2026

    Monid Tool Router joins with 2,600+ endpoints

    Monid's catalog brings more than 2,600 pay-per-call endpoints from over 80 upstream providers, led by TikHub, AnyAPI, DataForSEO and Strale, priced in RLUSD. Its first payment settled on Oct 20.

  3. FeatureOct 19, 2026

    The directory groups large catalogs by provider

    A merchant that resells many APIs now shows one directory card per upstream provider, each with that provider's logo, so you can find Exa or DefiLlama inside a larger catalog.

  4. FeatureOct 19, 2026

    Check sessions (beta) in the Build guide

    The Build guide now covers x402 batch settlement on XRPL Checks: one CheckCreate up to a ceiling, a session key signs each request, and the merchant cashes the Check once. x402-xrpl 0.4.0b1 already supports it.
